ontario-social-studies-g2-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Social Studies Grade 2 - Overall Expectations
ontario-social-studies-g2-all-strands.documentVersion: Ontario Social Studies, History, and Geography Curriculum (2026)

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions
standards.summaryText: compare some significant traditions and celebrations among diverse groups and at different times, including those of First Nations, Métis, and/or Inuit, and identify some of the reasons for changes in these traditions/celebrations
standards.officialOutcomeText: compare some significant traditions and celebrations among diverse groups and at different times, including those of First Nations, Métis, and/or Inuit, and identify some of the reasons for changes in these traditions/celebrations
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions
standards.summaryText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some of the past and present traditions and celebrations within their own family and the communities to which they belong
standards.officialOutcomeText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some of the past and present traditions and celebrations within their own family and the communities to which they belong
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions
standards.summaryText: describe some of the major groups in their community, including First Nations, Métis, and/or Inuit, other diverse communities, and different types of families, and some of the ways in which traditions and heritage are passed on by such groups
standards.officialOutcomeText: describe some of the major groups in their community, including First Nations, Métis, and/or Inuit, other diverse communities, and different types of families, and some of the ways in which traditions and heritage are passed on by such groups
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Changing Family and Community Traditions

standards.summaryText: describe some similarities and differences in the ways in which people in two or more communities in different parts of the world meet their needs and have adapted to the location, climate, and physical features of their regions
standards.officialOutcomeText: describe some similarities and differences in the ways in which people in two or more communities in different parts of the world meet their needs and have adapted to the location, climate, and physical features of their regions

standards.summaryText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate aspects of the interrelationship between the natural environment, including the climate, of selected communities, including at least one contemporary First Nation, Métis, or Inuit community, and the ways in which people in those communities live
standards.officialOutcomeText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate aspects of the interrelationship between the natural environment, including the climate, of selected communities, including at least one contemporary First Nation, Métis, or Inuit community, and the ways in which people in those communities live

standards.summaryText: identify and locate various physical features and selected communities around the world, including at least one contemporary First Nation, Métis, or Inuit community, and describe some aspects of peoples ways of life in those communities
standards.officialOutcomeText: identify and locate various physical features and selected communities around the world, including at least one contemporary First Nation, Métis, or Inuit community, and describe some aspects of peoples ways of life in those communities
